title: A lifetime license for Office on Mac is $90 right now
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: Renewing Microsoft 365 every year adds up fast. Get a lifetime license to Microsoft Office Home and Business 2021 for Mac for $89.97 (reg. $219) and own the core Office apps outright.

This license covers Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, a basic version of Teams, and the free version of OneNote, installed on one Mac for lifetime use at home or for work. It’s a one-time purchase tied to a Microsoft account rather than a specific device, so reinstalling later doesn’t require buying it again. Again, Microsoft Office Home and Business 2021 for Mac is available here for just $89.97.

Word, Excel, and PowerPoint Without the Subscription

The license supports the three most recent versions of macOS, currently macOS Sonoma, Sequoia, and Tahoe, with Microsoft rolling support forward as new versions launch and phasing out the oldest one.

Delivery is instant. License keys and download links arrive by email right after purchase, and any redemption code must be used within 7 days of purchase. Free customer support is included if setup runs into any snags along the way.

For anyone who’s tired of a recurring Office bill and just wants the core apps running reliably on a Mac, this is a straightforward way to skip the subscription entirely. Get Microsoft Office Home and Business 2021 for Mac for $89.97 (reg. $219) while this price holds.
